statement: Let M be a type III1 factor with separable predual and ϕ a faithful normal state. (i) If B = BC(M, ϕ) is nonscalar, then B is a type III1 subfactor with a normal ϕ-preserving conditional expectation, and BC(B, ϕ|B) = B. (ii) There is a continuous ϕ-preserving action βϕ : R∗ + ↷ BC(M, ϕ) characterized by ∥wnϕ − λϕwn∥M∗ −→ 0 =⇒ wna − βϕ λ(a)wn −→ 0 ∗ -strongly for every λ > 0, every uniformly bounded sequence (wn) in M, and every a ∈ BC(M, ϕ). (iii) The fixed-point algebra of βϕ is C1.
